scope: Candidate versus approved original; before matched baseline images or prior score/review records. Construction report was read and contains qualitative historical summaries; this is not a fully blinded review.
judgment: Recognizably the reference creature and cohesive low-poly wood/leaf construction, but long linear armored thorax, thick elbow/shoulder geometry, mask-like narrow beak, regular straight-sided leaf fan and broad flat ivory blade surfaces remain materially less organic and lively than the original.

view_notes.hero: Strong iconography; mask and chest planes conspicuous, heavy shoulders despite narrowed arms.
view_notes.front: Symmetric humanoid raised-arm read; clear green eyes but rigid mask and triangular chest slabs.
view_notes.back: Leaf color/facets work, still orderly paddle fan with blunt low-poly abdomen.
view_notes.left: Long straight neck dominates; crown spikes and extended pointed mask remain.
view_notes.right: Same long armored diagonal; root fan feels constructed rather than growing.
view_notes.top: Full spatial geometry visible; massive continuous thorax and regular four-leaf arrangement.
view_notes.diag-front: Green eyes readable; inward blade teeth broad, arms angular and heavy.
view_notes.diag-back: Back anatomy plausible interpretation; mostly flat broad leaf panels.
view_notes.diag-left: Paired toes improve feet; side silhouette has a rodlike armored thorax.
view_notes.diag-right: Facets coherent; cheek/jaw and brow still hard planar mask rather than reference expression.
